There’s nothing quite as yummy or delicious as picking your favorite fresh fruit and immediately
enjoying the fruits of your labor. Visit our beautiful orchards to pick your own fruit directly from

The Garden Center at Cherry Hill Orchards has a wide variety of annuals, perennials, vegetables,

Cherry Hill Orchards is the largest pick-your-own fruit farm, farm market and garden center in

This easy **Hot Honey Pepperoni Pasta Bake** is the ultimate one-pan comfort food. Made with
rigatoni, melty mozzarella, pepperoni, and [Cherry Republic's Beekeeper's Cherry Hot Honey,][115]
it's a sweet, spicy, and cheesy dinner that's perfect for busy weeknights or casual entertaining.

🍁 ½–1 tbsp pure maple syrup

🍋 1 tsp lemon juice

🥤 Club soda

✨ Top with club soda
✨ Stir gently and enjoy

and our team of Stemilters so that we grow fresh apples, pears and cherries that delight people.

## Our Partner Success Stories
* ### Enabling Scalable Omnichannel Fulfillment With Hai Robotics
  
  Growing SKU assortments and limited warehouse space require solutions that maximize storage
  density without compromising flexibility. Discover we combine high-density robotic storage,
  seamless software integration, smart warehouse processes and operational expertise to create
  scalable, future-ready omnichannel fulfillment operations together with our partner Hai Robotics.
  
  [ Read more ][85]
* ### SCALING WAREHOUSE AUTOMATION WITH UNCHAINED ROBOTICS
  
  Automation has helped to address challenges such as labor shortages and increasing cost pressure
  in global supply chains. But rising complexity is a challenge that cannot be mastered simply by
  adding more automation. Discover how Arvato and Unchained Robotics develop modular,
  vendor-independent robotics solutions designed for real-world logistics environments.
  
  [ Read more ][86]
* ### EXPANDING OUR AUTOSTORE™ SYSTEM TO ACCELERATE OUR CLIENTS’ GROWTH
  
  We enable our clients to scale by delivering faster, smarter, and more flexible fulfillment.
  Discover how we are boosting capacity and fulfillment performance together with AutoStore in our
  success story.
  
  [ Read more ][87]
* ### OPTIMIZED OMNICHANNEL LOGISTICS FOR BEAUTY PRODUCTS WITH KNAPP'S EVO SHUTTLE 2D
  
  We enable higher throughput for B2B and B2C on a conveyor line while ensuring the flexibility
  required for online business, by using a shuttle system. Discover more about the successful
  implementation with our partner KNAPP in our success story.
* ### ROBOTIC TRUCK UNLOADING WITH BOSTON DYNAMICS' STRETCH ROBOT
  
  Automating every step of the inbound process is essential to our automation strategy. To improve
  the speed and safety of freight unloading, we have complemented the manual unloading process with
  the addition of Boston Dynamics' Stretch robot. Find out more about the successful implementation
  with our partner Boston Dynamics in our success story.
* ### SAP ON AZURE – THE RIGHT DECISION FOR A GROWING BUSINESS
  
  With our SAP on Azure migration we established a future-proof IT infrastructure that enables us to
  manage our clients’ operations across countries and optimize their supply chain on a global scale.
  Discover our success story featuring our successful SAP on Azure migration project with our
  partner Microsoft.
* ### TRANSFORMING OUR COLLABORATION CULTURE WITH MICROSOFT 365
  
  The Microsoft Modern Workplace plays a crucial role in fostering our global culture of
  collaboration, breaking down silos, and establishing a more efficient, transparent, and
  forward-thinking organization. In our success story, we detail the implementation of M365 in
  collaboration with our partner Microsoft.

# Welcome to Cherry

[All Products]

[All Products]

Cherry® Aerospace is a global leader for aerospace blind fastening systems. [CherryMAX®][52]
products are the most widely-used blind fasteners in the industry. The Cherry® brand
[originated][53] in 1940 when the Cherry Rivet Company introduced the first blind fasteners, quickly
adopted by the industry.

Our headquarters and manufacturing facility is located in Santa Ana, California (USA). We are part
of [Precision Castparts Corp (PCC)][54], [ Fastener Products Division][55].

Cherry's products are sold across the globe via authorized [Distributors][56], and include
aerospace-grade [Blind Rivets][57], [Blind Bolts][58], [Rivetless Nut Plates][59], [Specialized
Solid Rivets and Shear Pins][60], and the associated [Installation Tools][61]. See our [Master
Catalog][62] for further details.

Our experienced [Technical Support][63] staff can help you select the right fasteners and tooling
for your application, troubleshoot application issues, and provide details and answer questions
regarding [Fastener][64] and [Tool][65] warranties. Tool service and repairs are conducted by
certified [U.S.][66] and [International][67] repair centers.

You will find our [Product Expert][68] online database very useful, providing industry part number
cross references and recommended installation tooling.

# Welcome to Cherry

[All Products]

[All Products]

Cherry® Aerospace is a global leader for aerospace blind fastening systems. [CherryMAX®][52]
products are the most widely-used blind fasteners in the industry. The Cherry® brand
[originated][53] in 1940 when the Cherry Rivet Company introduced the first blind fasteners, quickly
adopted by the industry.

Our headquarters and manufacturing facility is located in Santa Ana, California (USA). We are part
of [Precision Castparts Corp (PCC)][54], [ Fastener Products Division][55].

Cherry's products are sold across the globe via authorized [Distributors][56], and include
aerospace-grade [Blind Rivets][57], [Blind Bolts][58], [Rivetless Nut Plates][59], [Specialized
Solid Rivets and Shear Pins][60], and the associated [Installation Tools][61]. See our [Master
Catalog][62] for further details.

Our experienced [Technical Support][63] staff can help you select the right fasteners and tooling
for your application, troubleshoot application issues, and provide details and answer questions
regarding [Fastener][64] and [Tool][65] warranties. Tool service and repairs are conducted by
certified [U.S.][66] and [International][67] repair centers.

You will find our [Product Expert][68] online database very useful, providing industry part number
cross references and recommended installation tooling.

## The Montmorency Cherry

The Montmorency cherry is a beautiful tart cherry variety grown on small family farms across North
America. Almost all the Montmorency tart cherries consumed in the U.S. are locally grown. More than
94% of the Montmorency tart cherries consumed are grown in the United States.

When you choose Montmorency cherries instead of other imported options, you support small family
farmers that have been at this for generations. Check out your local grocery store for Montmorency
tart cherries so you can discover the great taste and awesome health benefits for yourself. From our
farms to your family.

Who Is

## Cherry Central?

[ READ MORE ][53]

Cherry Central is a farmer-owned cooperative that believes we are stronger when we work together.
Today, Cherry Central comprises hundreds of small family farms. Just as our farmers have been
innovating for generations, so is Cherry Central. Cherry Central is committed to the power of good.
We lead with service, focusing on creating good and nutritious food.

[Apple Sketch]

What

## We Grow

[A close up of delicious cherries.]
[A sketch of fruit.]

#### Fresh

Our cherries, apples, and other high-quality fruits and vegetables are grown in America, picked at
the peak of ripeness and processed to preserve their taste and nutrients.

every bit of goodness no matter where you buy them.

The

# Montmorency Cherry

[ PLAY VIDEO ][56]

## The Montmorency Cherry

The Montmorency cherry is a beautiful tart cherry variety grown on small family farms across North
America. Almost all the Montmorency tart cherries consumed in the U.S. are locally grown. More than
94% of the Montmorency tart cherries consumed are grown in the United States.

When you choose Montmorency cherries instead of other imported options, you support small family
farmers that have been at this for generations. Check out your local grocery store for Montmorency
tart cherries so you can discover the great taste and awesome health benefits for yourself. From our
farms to your family.

[Cherry Sketch]
[Flower Sketch]

## Product Quality

Cherry Central is your dependable source for the finest fruit and asparagus products.

As a recognized leader in the fruit processing industry, Cherry Central continuously develops
innovative fruit and other food products for domestic use and export.

[Farmer holding cherries]
[Orchard barn]

## Health Benefits
## of the Montmorency Cherry

The health benefits of Montmorency cherries are mounting—these luscious fruits improve arthritis and
gout symptoms, aid in exercise recovery, improve sleep, heart health, and gut health.

[ LEARN MORE ][57]

## Health Benefits
## of the Montmorency Cherry

The health benefits of Montmorency cherries are mounting—these luscious fruits improve arthritis and
gout symptoms, aid in exercise recovery, improve sleep, heart health, and gut health.

## Why do industry leaders choose Conectiv?

We provide comprehensive supply chain solutions for businesses across a multitude of industries.
From B2B & DTC warehousing and distribution to e-commerce solutions, from POS Displays to Global
Freight Solutions, from Vinyl Record Manufacturing to Packaged Media Production; Conectiv covers it
all.

**Industry Specialization**

Our depth of knowledge in the media & entertainment, merchandise fulfillment and consumer goods
sectors enables Conectiv to serve clients with specialized capabilities.

**Unrivaled Heritage**

Over a century of innovation has refined every aspect of our process, and this experience has
enabled us to overcome virtually every challenge imaginable.

**True Partnership**

Businesses need more than production; they need real partnership. More than a service provider, we
provide integrated solutions that connect your products to global markets.

**Scalable Solutions**

Your needs tomorrow won’t match your needs today. Our flexible systems expand seamlessly as your
business grows, with warehouse and distribution services designed to accommodate sudden demand
spikes without service disruptions.

**High Quality at Every Step**

Details matter. From decisive manufacturing tolerances to meticulous inventory management, we
approach every project with industry standards that eliminate errors before they occur.

**Sustainable Practices**

The future of physical media manufacturing must be both innovative and responsible. Our ISCC Plus
certification demonstrates our commitment to sustainable practices that benefit your business and
our planet.

**End-to-End Accountability**

When we handle your supply chain solutions, there’s never a question of responsibility. Our
integrated approach means one partner, one conversation, and one solution from initial concept
through final delivery.

**Technology-Forward Approach**

We embrace advanced technology throughout our operations, with real-time analytics, automation, and
robust systems that give you comprehensive visibility and control.

## **Partner with Conectiv**

[Vinyl Record Solutions]

### [Vinyl Record Solutions][27]
* **On-Site Lacquer Cutting**: Master audio transformed into lacquer masters.
* **Color Matching**: Custom vinyl colors and effects to match your artistic vision.
* **Short-Run Flexibility**: From limited indie runs to major releases with consistent quality.
* **Industry Standards**: Rigorous quality control maintained throughout the pressing process.
* **Sustainable Packaging Solutions**: Built for impact, from 7” & 12” records to Box Sets

##### [Third-Party Logistics (3PL)][28]
* **Warehouse & Inventory Management:** Comprehensive storage and real-time inventory tracking.
* ** Pick, Pack & Ship: **Big box retail fulfillment for B2B and DTC channels.
* **POS Display Builds: **Eye-catching point of sale materials that drive engagement.
* **Value-Added Services: **Complex kitting, assembly, and retail display solutions.
* **Omni-Channel Distribution:** Seamless integration across retail,
  e-commerce, and wholesale channels.

##### [Optical Disc Manufacturing][29]
* **Disc Replication:** High-volume DVD, Blu-ray, UHD, and CD manufacturing capabilities.
* **Multi-Disc Sets:** Complex configurations with capabilities for custom serialization.
* **Content Security: **Industry-leading protection protocols for intellectual property.
* **Integrated Packaging:** Complete packaging solutions from disc production to final assembly.

### Kids Room | Modern Bright Haven

#### This modern children’s room blends simplicity with playful charm, creating a bright and
#### cheerful space. Clean lines and minimalistic furniture provide a calm and organized
#### environment, while pops of color in textiles, wall art, and accessories add personality and
#### fun. Thoughtful storage solutions keep toys and books neatly arranged, encouraging independence
#### and tidiness. Soft rugs, cozy seating, and versatile play areas make the room both comfortable
#### and functional. Ample natural light enhances the sense of openness, creating a lively yet
#### soothing atmosphere. The design balances practicality with creativity, offering a stylish and
#### inspiring space where children can play, learn, and grow every day.

### Bedroom | Luxurious Scarlet Elegance

#### This luxurious red bedroom exudes bold sophistication and dramatic elegance. Deep red tones on
#### walls, bedding, and upholstery create a warm, intimate atmosphere, while plush textures like
#### velvet and silk add richness and comfort. Sleek metallic accents, mirrored surfaces, and
#### carefully curated lighting enhance the opulent feel without overwhelming the senses. Minimalist
#### yet refined furniture ensures functionality while maintaining a sense of grandeur. Thoughtful
#### layering of fabrics, rugs, and cushions creates depth and visual interest, balancing intensity
#### with serenity. The overall design offers a glamorous and indulgent retreat, where luxury meets
#### comfort, making the bedroom both striking and inviting.

### Outdoor Living | Modern Natural Wood

#### This modern outdoor living space embraces the warmth and texture of natural wood, creating a
#### serene and inviting retreat. Wooden decking and furniture pieces with clean lines blend
#### seamlessly with lush greenery, while neutral cushions and textiles add comfort and understated
#### elegance. Minimalist design ensures the space feels open and uncluttered, emphasizing harmony
#### with the surrounding nature. Thoughtful lighting highlights the wood’s natural grain and
#### creates a cozy ambiance for evening gatherings. Durable materials ensure longevity and
#### practicality without compromising style. The overall atmosphere is calm, organic, and
#### sophisticated, offering a perfect balance of modern design and natural tranquility for outdoor
#### living.

### Kids Room | Modern Playful Minimalism

#### This modern children’s room combines simplicity with playful energy, creating a bright and
#### inviting space. Clean lines, minimalistic furniture, and neutral base tones provide a calm
#### backdrop, while colorful accents, wall art, and soft textiles add personality and fun.
#### Thoughtful storage solutions keep toys and books organized, promoting both functionality and
#### independence. Natural light fills the room, enhancing the sense of openness and warmth. Soft
#### rugs and comfortable seating areas encourage reading, play, and relaxation. The design balances
#### practicality with creativity, offering a safe, stylish, and cheerful environment where children
#### can grow, explore, and feel inspired every day.

### Living Room | Modern Light Luxury Yellow

#### This modern light luxury living room showcases a vibrant yet sophisticated yellow palette,
#### creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. A plush velvet sofa in golden tones serves as the
#### centerpiece, offering both comfort and a touch of elegance. Clean lines, subtle metallic
#### accents, and refined furniture pieces enhance the contemporary aesthetic without overwhelming
#### the space. Natural light and carefully positioned ambient lighting emphasize textures and
#### colors, adding depth and richness. Thoughtful details like soft rugs, decorative cushions, and
#### minimalist art bring harmony to the design. The result is a chic, cozy, and luxurious living
#### space that radiates energy while maintaining modern sophistication.

### Living Room | Modern Marble Luxury

#### This modern light luxury living room is centered around the timeless elegance of marble.
#### Large-format marble surfaces with natural veining create a refined and sophisticated focal
#### point, while soft neutral tones keep the space balanced and inviting. Sleek furniture, subtle
#### metallic accents, and clean architectural lines enhance the contemporary feel without
#### overpowering the design. Carefully planned lighting highlights the texture and depth of the
#### marble, adding a sense of quiet luxury. The overall atmosphere is elegant yet comfortable,
#### blending premium materials with modern simplicity to create a living space that feels polished,
#### calm, and enduring.

### Laundry Room | Modern Clean Function

#### This modern laundry room is designed with clarity, efficiency, and simplicity in mind. A
#### neutral color palette, sleek cabinetry, and smooth surfaces create a clean and organized visual
#### experience. Built-in storage and integrated appliances maximize space while keeping the room
#### clutter-free. Subtle lighting and minimal detailing highlight the functional layout without
#### unnecessary decoration. Durable materials ensure easy maintenance, making the space practical
#### for daily use. Overall, the design focuses on smart functionality and modern aesthetics,
#### transforming the laundry room into a streamlined, comfortable, and highly efficient part of the
#### home.

### Living Room | Modern Retro Harmony

#### This modern retro living room blends classic character with contemporary comfort.
#### Vintage-inspired furniture silhouettes and warm color tones are balanced with clean lines and
#### modern materials, creating a space that feels both nostalgic and fresh. Textured fabrics, wood
#### elements, and subtle metal details add depth and personality to the interior. Carefully curated
#### décor references retro design without overwhelming the space. Soft, layered lighting enhances
#### the cozy atmosphere while maintaining a modern aesthetic. The result is a welcoming living room
#### that celebrates timeless design, offering a perfect balance between past influences and
#### present-day living.

### Kids’ Room | Modern Beige Comfort

#### This modern beige kids’ room is designed to feel warm, calm, and timeless. Soft beige tones
#### create a gentle backdrop that promotes relaxation while allowing the space to grow with the
#### child. Natural materials, rounded furniture edges, and cozy textiles add a sense of safety and
#### comfort. The clean, modern layout keeps the room organized and functional, with smart storage
#### solutions for toys and books. Subtle color variations and textures prevent the palette from
#### feeling flat. Overall, the design balances aesthetics and practicality, creating a soothing yet
#### playful environment that supports rest, creativity, and everyday activities.

### Home Bar | Light Luxury Social Corner

WHY DP WORLD?

## ANYTHING. ANYWHERE.

No matter your size or sector, we can help you scale your trade through our global end-to-end
infrastructure. From local entrepreneurs to global enterprises, we connect you to the markets,
resources, and opportunities that matter most. 

MAKE AN IMPACT

## WE MOVE 10% OF GLOBAL TRADE DAILY

DP World plays a vital role in keeping global trade moving by connecting economies, industries and
businesses worldwide. 

A SINGLE PLATFORM FOR TRADE

chain. That's the DP World advantage.

### **History of Electric Switches**

Electric switches have a long and innovative history, born out of the need to safely and reliably
control the flow of electricity. The earliest electric switches were simple light switches, invented

engineering. In preparation for the 1880 New Year’s celebration, Edison created a number of
electrical components for a light display. Among these components were [switches][96] specifically
designed to make lighting control more practical and user-friendly.

break switch. This innovation prevented residue buildup from electrical arcing, significantly
enhancing the durability and lifespan of switches and improving electrical safety. The quick break
mechanism also sped up the process by reducing the time needed for two electric contacts to meet
within a circuit. By the late 19th century, push button switches had become quite popular, helping
to popularize electrically powered lighting in homes and businesses.

switch][97], inspired by the quick break switch. Even today, the toggle switch remains a common
feature in North American homes, serving as the everyday light switch and a staple of residential

connectivity are set to redefine electric switch technology even further, enabling safer, more
efficient, and highly customizable solutions for both industrial and consumer applications.

## Schurter Series: DG11 IEC Appliance Inlet with Circuit Breaker

[Image]

**DG11 IEC Appliance Inlet C14 or C18 with Circuit Breaker TA35 2-pole with ****Thermal or
Thermal-Magnetic Release**

[Schurter DG11]

The Schurter DG11 is a power entry module designed
for IEC appliance inlets (C14 or C18) combined with
a 2‑pole TA35 circuit breaker offering thermal or
thermal‑magnetic release. It is intended for use in
equipment protected to IEC/UL 62368‑1 and suitable
for protection class I or II devices.

It provides a reliable alternative to traditional
fuse-protected power entries by featuring resettable
overcurrent protection, reducing components, and
removing the need for a separate fuse.

**Description:**
* Panel mount: Screw-on version from front or rear side, snap-in version front side: Appliance
  Inlet, protection class I or II, Circuit breaker type TA35, 2-pole, with thermal or
  thermal-magnetic release
* Pre-wired coupling
* V-Lock notch standard
* Quick connect terminal 6.3 x 0.8 mm

**Key Features:**
* With sealing: IP54 under load, IP67 towards housing
* Thermal or thermal-magnetic circuit breaker; thermal-magnetic release fast acting or with time lag
* Recessed rocker prevents accidental manipulation
* Various mounting options

**Characteristics:**
* Connector and circuit breaker are prewired
* Circuit Breaker thermal or thermal-magnetic, non-illuminated or illuminated
* Suitable for use in equipment according to IEC/UL 62368-1

**Applications:**
* Medical Equipment
* Industrial Automation & Control
* IT & Telecommunications
* Audio, Video, & Lighting

## Schurter Series: DG11 IEC Appliance Inlet with Circuit Breaker

[Image]

**DG11 IEC Appliance Inlet C14 or C18 with Circuit Breaker TA35 2-pole with ****Thermal or
Thermal-Magnetic Release**

[Schurter DG11]

The Schurter DG11 is a power entry module designed
for IEC appliance inlets (C14 or C18) combined with
a 2‑pole TA35 circuit breaker offering thermal or
thermal‑magnetic release. It is intended for use in
equipment protected to IEC/UL 62368‑1 and suitable
for protection class I or II devices.

It provides a reliable alternative to traditional
fuse-protected power entries by featuring resettable
overcurrent protection, reducing components, and
removing the need for a separate fuse.

**Description:**
* Panel mount: Screw-on version from front or rear side, snap-in version front side: Appliance
  Inlet, protection class I or II, Circuit breaker type TA35, 2-pole, with thermal or
  thermal-magnetic release
* Pre-wired coupling
* V-Lock notch standard
* Quick connect terminal 6.3 x 0.8 mm

**Key Features:**
* With sealing: IP54 under load, IP67 towards housing
* Thermal or thermal-magnetic circuit breaker; thermal-magnetic release fast acting or with time lag
* Recessed rocker prevents accidental manipulation
* Various mounting options

**Characteristics:**
* Connector and circuit breaker are prewired
* Circuit Breaker thermal or thermal-magnetic, non-illuminated or illuminated
* Suitable for use in equipment according to IEC/UL 62368-1

**Applications:**
* Medical Equipment
* Industrial Automation & Control
* IT & Telecommunications
* Audio, Video, & Lighting

industrial electrical and mechanical equipment to a broad spectrum of industries.

The grooves in plastic cutting boards harbor billions of bacteria, where they grow and proliferate
for hours or days after use. End grain wood kills bacteria in minutes.
X
Knife-Friendly Cutting Surface
End grain wood is the only surface your knives should ever touch. Other surfaces — including long
grain wood and plastic — dull knife blades almost immediately, making them difficult and unsafe to
use.
X
Staggered for Strength
Varying block lengths and staggered seams make our boards the strongest and most durable you’ll ever
find. No warping, no delamination.
X
American Black Cherry: The Ideal Wood Type
The perfect density wood, responsibly harvested and 100% safe for food contact — unlike tropical
(teak, mahogany) and reclaimed woods, which can harbor dangerous toxins.
X
Hand Clamped and Glued
In order to truly prevent delamination, it’s critical to clamp and glue the board by hand instead of
using an automated process like radio-frequency gluing. The problem is, virtually no one does this —
except for us.

## Uniquely handcrafted for your life

The smell of freshly-lit charcoal. The sweet, tangy taste of great barbecue. Few activities match
the pure, primal satisfaction of cooking outdoors. True greatness at the grill is something that
takes a lifetime to master, but it’s the process that brings the greatest joy. But to undertake this
journey, you need to arm yourself with tools that can withstand the rigors of the trade. Fifth &
Cherry makes competition grade, end grain boards that are as tough as your standards for great
cooking, with looks to match. So whether you caught it, hunted it, or bought it from the store,
everything you cook is going to look better on a Fifth & Cherry board.

[Learn More ][21]

The most enjoyable part of giving a Fifth & Cherry board as a gift is watching the recipient’s face
when they first lay eyes on it. Even before they fully understand the benefits of owning a Fifth &
Cherry board, they recognize that they’ve never quite seen anything like it. But as any great gift
giver knows, the most meaningful part of a gift is never the physical object. As your recipient’s
new board becomes woven into the fabric of their everyday life, as it becomes a centerpiece of some
of their most cherished memories with family and friends, the true meaning of your gift will start
to take shape.

Cooking is your art, your passion. Most people don’t know how much attention, care, and obsessive
crafting goes into creating the perfect dish. The attention to detail, the endless study of process
and craft. Fifth & Cherry makes boards for people who know that to create the best finished works,
you have to start with the best tools (and a healthy dose of obsession). Beautiful and functional, a
Fifth & Cherry^{®} board is an investment in your craft, an emblem of your commitment to excellence.

As we grow older, we recognize more and more how precious the opportunities are to make real,
lasting connections with family and friends. But even when we do make efforts to spend more quality
time together, it can be a challenge finding ways to get everyone to unplug for a while and just be
present. Creating something together is one of the greatest ways to connect and create the vivid
memories that make our lives meaningful. Cooking has always been one of the best ways to share
important moments across generations. At Fifth & Cherry, we are honored to make products that play a
role, however small, in creating those lasting bonds with the people who are most important to you.

Bringing people together is a passion of yours, and nothing makes you happier than delighting your
guests with great food and great conversation. You appreciate the finer things in life, but even
more so when you get to share them with others. A Fifth & Cherry board is meant to serve as more
than just a cutting block. When used as a centerpiece or a serving platter, the natural wood finish
creates a sense of unpretentious warmth and elegance. And because the end grain wood reduces knife
marks, it can go from prep to presentation in the same night. A Fifth & Cherry board makes for a
great conversation piece, and it’s so beautiful you’ll want to photograph it over and over again.

## It’s more than a cutting board.

Food nourishes the body and soul and unites people in a unique way. When food is shared together,
it’s more than just a meal; it’s an experience. It shapes our memories and strengthens our bonds. No
matter what you’re cooking or who you’re cooking for, we believe that memories created in the
kitchen should last forever. For the past 30 years, we’ve been handcrafting one-of-a-kind, high-end
cutting boards to help us remember our most special moments shared with those we love.

**And for us, love is what it’s all about.**

# Partner with foodguys
# Supplying Bulk Ingredients By The Pallet, Truckload, and Container

Bulk Ingredients, industrial ingredient sourcing, negotiating, transporting, and delivering the bulk
industrial ingredients you need from our vast worldwide networks - foodguys is your one-stop-shop!
We have the resources and expertise to provide you with all-encompassing ingredient solutions to
your industrial ingredient needs. is a bulk ingredient supplier for manufacturers in the food and
beverage (human-grade, baby, and pet food), personal care, beauty, and nutraceutical industry. In
addition, foodguys works with retailers, distributors, food service operators to provide bulk

01
[F logo]
Fathom.ai
Fathom.ai is a free AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes, and summarizes calls on Zoom,
Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams. The company was founded in 2020 by Richard White, a computer
science engineer who previously co-built UserVoice over roughly 12 years, scaling it to $10 million
in revenue before transitioning out in 2019. Fathom has grown from $100K ARR in 2022 to $1M in 2023,
$10M in 2024, and $30M in 2025, a trajectory White describes as "zero to one, one to 10, and 10 to
30 in the first three years of monetization." The company has raised $30 million total across three
rounds, including a $10M seed in 2021, a $3M seed in 2023, and a $17M Series A in 2024 at a $73M
valuation. The team has grown to 100 people. Average revenue per customer is approximately $25 per
seat with an average of 8 to 10 seats, putting the typical account around $200 per month. The single
most distinctive strategic fact is that Fathom gave its core product away for free even while losing
$50 per user per month in its early years, betting that transcription costs would fall to near zero.
That bet proved correct, and the free individual tier became the distribution engine for a paid team
product, allowing Fathom to reach hundreds of thousands of daily users and $30M ARR while raising
far less capital than any of its major competitors.

including AI-generated captions and clip extraction from long-form video. The company was founded in
May 2023 by David Zitoun and his co-founder, and is headquartered in France with most of its revenue
coming from the United States. Zitoun serves as Co-Founder and CEO and runs the company with a team
of 13 people. SubMagic reached $1M ARR exactly three months after acquiring its first customer in
May 2023, hitting that milestone on August 1, 2023. By June 2025, the company had grown to $8M ARR,
fully bootstrapped with no outside funding. The company sees between 5,000 and 10,000 new signups
per day, converted roughly 2,500 new paid customers in its most recent month, and carries a monthly
logo churn rate of approximately 15%. Its affiliate program, which pays 30% of lifetime customer
value, accounts for more than 10,000 active affiliates and directly drives 20% of total revenue. The
single most striking strategic fact is that SubMagic scaled from zero to $8M ARR in two years with
13 employees, generating roughly $700,000 of revenue per employee, by combining precise timing with
the short-form content boom, a generous affiliate program launched within 30 days of its first
customer, and a relentless focus on a three-click product experience rather than paid acquisition.

# Global smart farm assurance solutions

We offer a portfolio of robust, streamlined, and easy-to-use solutions for the certification of
agriculture, aquaculture, and floriculture production processes. With our standards, delivery
services, and capacity building program, we foster the global adoption of safer and more responsible
farming practices in more than 130 countries worldwide.

[ About us ][81]

#### Tickets are now live

Secure your place at [AGRAYA SUMMIT 2026][82]. Be part of the conversations shaping the future of
agriculture and connect with key voices from across the sector.

[ Go to ticket shop ][83]

#### The Changemaker Awards return!

Shining a light on positive change in the world of agriculture, the Changemakers will be celebrated
at our upcoming SUMMIT 2026.

Apply by 15 May to elevate your work on a global stage!

[ How to apply ][84]

#### Discover Agraya

The new website of our corporate home is live – connecting people, ideas, and solutions across the
global farming network.  

[ Visit Agraya.com ][85]

#### Certificate validation

The GLOBALG.A.P. Database was retired on 3 November 2025. Certificate verification is now handled
through the Supply Chain Portal.

[ Learn more ][86]

### Corporate news and events have moved!

All the latest updates can now be found on the Agraya website – connecting people, ideas, and
solutions across the global farming network.

[ Visit Agraya.com ][87]

## What we do

We set standards for primary production and the supply chain. From fruits and flowers to fish and
feed, our portfolio is based on a robust third-party certification system that is developed in
collaboration with sector stakeholders and strengthened by an innovative IT platform. Our holistic
solutions and broader activities support the six key impact areas of food safety, environment,
workers’ health, safety, and welfare, animal welfare, supply chain transparency, and capacity
building.

# Supply Chain Portal

Check the validity of a GLOBALG.A.P. certificate or letter of conformance – all you need is the
GLOBALG.A.P. identification number.

of certified plant production annually

##### 2.8 million+ metric tons

of aquaculture products from certified production processes annually

##### 21 million+ metric tons

of compound feed from certified production processes annually

### Our flagship standards

[
[Integrated Farm Assurance for fruit and vegetables]

##### Integrated Farm Assurance for fruit and vegetables

IFA is a global standard that aims to promote safer and more responsible farming practices in fruit
and vegetable production.

][90] [
[Integrated Farm Assurance for flowers and ornamentals]

##### Integrated Farm Assurance for flowers and ornamentals

IFA is a global standard that aims to promote safer and more responsible farming practices in flower
and ornamentals production.

][91] [

aquaculture production.

## Who we work with

Fostering the global adoption of safer and more responsible farming practices is a collective
effort, which is why GLOBALG.A.P. works with a global network of stakeholder parties. Through
working groups, capacity-building partners, and more than 440 member organizations from all sides of
the value chain in our GLOBALG.A.P. community, we strive to connect with as many contributors as
possible.

# Thank you to all our GLOBALG.A.P. Community Members for your support!

From major retailers to independent agricultural consultants, all our community members provide
valuable insights and support in improving our solutions.
[ Explore community membership ][94]

### Working with GLOBALG.A.P standards since 1997, I have seen the change they’ve brought – not only
### from the food safety perspective that is so important to consumers, but also as a practical tool
### that helps improve social and environmental aspects in the lives of smallholders all over the
### world.

Manal Saleh

Founder and General Manager of Blue Moon LLC and Associate GLOBALG.A.P. Community Member | Egypt

# GGN label

The GGN label is a cross-category consumer label that stands for certified, responsible farming and
transparency. Applicable to fruit and vegetables, farmed seafood, and flowers and plants which have
been produced in line with GLOBALG.A.P. standards, the GGN label helps you improve your competitive
edge and grow trust in your brand by making responsible farming visible on store shelves.
[ Join the GGN label initiative ][95]

### Our flagship standards

[
[Integrated Farm Assurance for fruit and vegetables]

##### Integrated Farm Assurance for fruit and vegetables

IFA is a global standard that aims to promote safer and more responsible farming practices in fruit
and vegetable production.

][90] [

##### Integrated Farm Assurance for flowers and ornamentals

IFA is a global standard that aims to promote safer and more responsible farming practices in flower
and ornamentals production.

aquaculture production.

## Who we work with

Fostering the global adoption of safer and more responsible farming practices is a collective
effort, which is why GLOBALG.A.P. works with a global network of stakeholder parties. Through
working groups, capacity-building partners, and more than 440 member organizations from all sides of
the value chain in our GLOBALG.A.P. community, we strive to connect with as many contributors as
possible.

# Thank you to all our GLOBALG.A.P. Community Members for your support!

From major retailers to independent agricultural consultants, all our community members provide
valuable insights and support in improving our solutions.
[ Explore community membership ][94]

### Working with GLOBALG.A.P standards since 1997, I have seen the change they’ve brought – not only
### from the food safety perspective that is so important to consumers, but also as a practical tool
### that helps improve social and environmental aspects in the lives of smallholders all over the
### world.

Manal Saleh

Founder and General Manager of Blue Moon LLC and Associate GLOBALG.A.P. Community Member | Egypt

# GGN label

The GGN label is a cross-category consumer label that stands for certified, responsible farming and
transparency. Applicable to fruit and vegetables, farmed seafood, and flowers and plants which have
been produced in line with GLOBALG.A.P. standards, the GGN label helps you improve your competitive
edge and grow trust in your brand by making responsible farming visible on store shelves.
[ Join the GGN label initiative ][95]

https://health.clevelandclinic.org/how-to-pick-the-running-shoe-that-is-best-for-you

[[Person walking dog and person running in a park, with person sitting on a bench]][44]
[Exercise & Fitness][45]

https://health.clevelandclinic.org/walking-vs-running

https://health.clevelandclinic.org/exercises-for-patellofemoral-pain-syndrome-pfps

https://health.clevelandclinic.org/whats-joggers-nipple-and-how-can-you-avoid-it

condition

https://health.clevelandclinic.org/how-to-become-a-faster-runner

By [Edorta Gorria][52]
July 24, 2026 at 9:00 am
[EcoRefurb]

EcoRefurb, Portugal's leading refurbished technology brand, has joined Open Icecat, making its
product content available to retailers, resellers, and channel partners through Icecat's global
product catalog. This partnership helps EcoRefurb distribute standardized product information while
supporting the growing demand for refurbished IT equipment across Europe. As organizations
increasingly embrace circular economy initiatives, refurbished technology has become an important
part of IT procurement strategies. However, presenting refurbished products online requires the same
level of quality and consistency as new devices. Through Open Icecat, EcoRefurb can provide partners
with structured product content that simplifies product onboarding and improves the digital customer
experience.…

a fruit is a product of a plant that includes its seeds.The term has various meanings related on
circumstances.

In non-technical use, like food arrangement, fruit commonly means the heavy seed-associated products
of particular plants that are sweet and eatable in the raw condition, such as apples, kiwi,
pomegranate, oranges, grapes and bananas.

Seed-associated constructions that do not suit this informal standard are normally named
differently, such as vegetables, pods, nut, ears and cones.

Security & compliance

## HIPAA built-in, not bolted on.

Enterprise-grade security for one of the most regulated industries in the world. Every workflow,
agent, and integration protects PHI by default.

HIPAA-compliant
Full compliance with the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act for all PHI.
SOC 2 Type II
Independently audited by Prescient Security, with continuous monitoring and verification via Vanta.
BAA on every paid plan
A Business Associate Agreement is included from the Starter tier, not an enterprise-only add-on.
256-bit AES encryption
All data encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.2+). Zero plaintext PHI.
API-only integrations
Every integration uses official APIs. No RPA, no screen scraping, no EHR ToS violations.
99.9% uptime SLA
Enterprise-grade reliability with real-time status monitoring at status.keragon.com.
Built for the agentic era
Keragon AI and Agents run under the same BAA with zero data retention, so PHI stays protected even
when AI does the work.

Update on the suspension of dog transport service to the United States

We would like to inform you that, due to the latest update from U.S. authorities, the temporary
suspension of the pet transport service to the United States on LATAM flights, will only apply to
dogs. This restriction will be in effect for all dog shipments with an entry date from July 31,
2024, until further notice. Only pets with Miami as their entry point to the United States will be
accepted on an exceptional basis.

This measure responds to the requirements set by the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
(CDC), effective from August 1, 2024. The new regulations aim to mitigate the public health risk
associated with the variant of the rabies virus (DMRVV), which can be transmitted to humans by dogs
and cats.

We apologize for any inconvenience this situation may cause. For customers with pet shipments
destined for Miami, we request that you review the new requirements through the official CDC
website: https://bit.ly/CDC-AnimalCare.

On August 31, we will provide an update on the status of the embargo. In the meantime, for specific
inquiries, please contact our Customer Care team at: pawssupport@latam.com.

[View More][41]

LATAM group increases cherry exports by more than 30%

* **The cargo subsidiaries of LATAM group operated with a cargo fleet of 20 planes for the season,
  thanks to the addition of a new cargo aircraft that allowed it to increase the offered capacity by
  16% compared to the previous year.**
* **Air transportation emerges as an essential alternative for cherry exporters, especially at the
  beginning of the season due to the expedite transit time, allowing cherries departing from
  Santiago, Chile, to arrive in China in just 45 hours.**

**Santiago, January 15, 2024. LATAM group is the largest air carrier of Chilean cherries by 2023,
with approximately 7,546 tons of this fruit exported from Chile, representing a 32% growth compared
to the previous year.**

**Chile leads in cherry exports in South America, and LATAM group plays an essential role,
transporting 30% of the total volume by air. The majority of cherries, around 90%, are destined for
Asia for Chinese New Year celebrations, while a smaller proportion is directed to other markets such
as the United States and Brazil.**

**With a focus on its customers, LATAM group prepared for the season by incorporating 19 weekly
frequencies from Santiago dedicated to cherries. The company also added a new cargo aircraft
temporarily to its fleet to provide more capacity for cherries and the upcoming high season for
flowers, bringing the total number of aircraft to 20 and allowing them to increase the offered
capacity for cherries compared to the previous year.**

**Despite challenges presented by rains in Chile significantly affecting cherry production, LATAM
Cargo achieved an important growth by the end of the year. Claudio Torres Faini, Commercial SVP in
South America at LATAM Cargo Chile, commented, "We are fully committed to providing our customers
with solutions tailored to their needs. In response to a challenging season, we have implemented
flexible measures, adjusting both flight frequencies and destinations. This has not only allowed us
to offer our customers a greater variety of alternatives but has also generated growth
opportunities, especially in the U.S. market."**

**LATAM group inaugurated the 2023-2024 season with the first shipment of Chilean cherries departing
from Santiago in mid-October to New Zealand, later transported to China through interline
agreements.**

* **The cargo subsidiaries of LATAM group operated with a cargo fleet of 20 planes for the season,
  thanks to the addition of a new cargo aircraft that allowed it to increase the offered capacity by
  16% compared to the previous year.**
* **Air transportation emerges as an essential alternative for cherry exporters, especially at the
  beginning of the season due to the expedite transit time, allowing cherries departing from
  Santiago, Chile, to arrive in China in just 45 hours.**

**Santiago, January 15, 2024. LATAM group is the largest air carrier of Chilean cherries by 2023,
with approximately 7,546 tons of this fruit exported from Chile, representing a 32% growth compared
to the previous year.**

**Chile leads in cherry exports in South America, and LATAM group plays an essential role,
transporting 30% of the total volume by air. The majority of cherries, around 90%, are destined for
Asia for Chinese New Year celebrations, while a smaller proportion is directed to other markets such
as the United States and Brazil.**

**With a focus on its customers, LATAM group prepared for the season by incorporating 19 weekly
frequencies from Santiago dedicated to cherries. The company also added a new cargo aircraft
temporarily to its fleet to provide more capacity for cherries and the upcoming high season for
flowers, bringing the total number of aircraft to 20 and allowing them to increase the offered
capacity for cherries compared to the previous year.**

**Despite challenges presented by rains in Chile significantly affecting cherry production, LATAM
Cargo achieved an important growth by the end of the year. Claudio Torres Faini, Commercial SVP in
South America at LATAM Cargo Chile, commented, "We are fully committed to providing our customers
with solutions tailored to their needs. In response to a challenging season, we have implemented
flexible measures, adjusting both flight frequencies and destinations. This has not only allowed us
to offer our customers a greater variety of alternatives but has also generated growth
opportunities, especially in the U.S. market."**

**LATAM group inaugurated the 2023-2024 season with the first shipment of Chilean cherries departing
from Santiago in mid-October to New Zealand, later transported to China through interline
agreements.**

Update on the suspension of dog transport service to the United States

We would like to inform you that, due to the latest update from U.S. authorities, the temporary
suspension of the pet transport service to the United States on LATAM flights, will only apply to
dogs. This restriction will be in effect for all dog shipments with an entry date from July 31,
2024, until further notice. Only pets with Miami as their entry point to the United States will be
accepted on an exceptional basis.

This measure responds to the requirements set by the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
(CDC), effective from August 1, 2024. The new regulations aim to mitigate the public health risk
associated with the variant of the rabies virus (DMRVV), which can be transmitted to humans by dogs
and cats.

We apologize for any inconvenience this situation may cause. For customers with pet shipments
destined for Miami, we request that you review the new requirements through the official CDC
website: https://bit.ly/CDC-AnimalCare.

On August 31, we will provide an update on the status of the embargo. In the meantime, for specific
inquiries, please contact our Customer Care team at: pawssupport@latam.com.

## Quality Policy

Marsh Electronics provides high value customer solutions with application support for our customer,
enhancing their production and logistics processes. We meet all applicable requirements, including
quality product delivered on-time. We value and measure customer satisfaction and promote continual
improvement.

When you need assistance in applying an electronic component, or need a component customized to fit
your application requirement, let Marsh Electronics support you. Our on-staff engineer and vendor
relations professionals will work with you to identify the requirement, find a solution, provide a
sample for testing, and support you through the qualification process. Marsh Electronics can help
you streamline the electronic application process with customized application support to fully
understand and better evaluate your application requirements. Our on-staff engineer and trained
sales staff will help you find the technical solutions that suit your needs, faster. Our engineer
will provide insight to technologies, end applications, and integrated solutions to your application
requirements. Marsh Electronics offers engineering ideas, application research and support,
customized circuit suggestions and product specifications. We also welcome in-depth discussions and
specialty application inquiries with our experts to provide you a tailored product quickly and cost
effectively.

Extremely useful tool. I love the sector classification, which is much more updated and relevant to

We split comps into 220+ granular categories across all industry verticals, with a special emphasis
on digital ecosystems. You can filter through tech themes like vertical AI applications or IoT as
well as compare to offline sectors like airlines or logistics.

[See more on sectors][12]

Multiples is an absolute game-changer and saved me countless hours of analysis. User-friendly UI,

[Adam Hajer]

Adam Hajer

Investor at Russmedia

[Sector Classification Built For Digital Age]

Use our white-label API to seamlessly integrate Multiples data within your existing Sheets or Excel
workflows, or build your own financial SaaS products powered by our data - significantly cheaper

VP at Atomico

Automate your Google Sheets and Excel valuation workflows, or build your own tools using our

Whether you're in business, government, journalism, activism, research or a consumer — [our

## It shouldn't be hard to get legal-entity data you can trust

And yet it is. Legal-entity information is dispersed across hundreds of business registers that are
hard to navigate and impossible to access at scale. Traditional company-data aggregators are no
longer the answer either, given their opaque processes and provenance.

Verifiable accuracy is more important than ever, and you should expect more.

You need data built on deep expertise, rigorous data models and [well-founded, forward-looking
principles][43]. Data sourced direct from primary sources, curated with clear decision-making and no
hidden bias, and defined by open not proprietary identifiers and standards. Data you know you can
trust.

[ Search now ][44]
[ Plug in our data ][45]

## OpenCorporates was born out of the same frustrations you experience every day

We believe a fairer, more prosperous and sustainable society can only be achieved with greater
corporate transparency.

Since 2010 we’ve been working with government agencies, NGOs and public-benefit groups to improve
the quality and accessibility of the foundational legal-entity data on which you depend.

Today we offer the world's largest open legal-entity database, providing a single unified set of 
company records from over 140 government registries and other official sources around the world.

[ 07 ] — Custom keycap FAQ

## Custom keycap manufacturing, answered.

The questions buyers ask us most about MOQ, lead time, artwork and materials for custom OEM / ODM
keycaps.

What is the MOQ for custom keycaps?

Minimum order quantity depends on the printing process. Double-shot keycaps have an MOQ of 2,000
sets, because each colorway needs dedicated mould time; dye-sublimation, silk-screen (pad) printing
and laser-engraved keycap sets start at 500 sets. Using an existing profile avoids new tooling —
send your spec for an exact figure.

How long is the sampling lead time?

Sampling takes about 3–5 days for dye-sublimation, silk-screen and laser-engraved keycaps, and
around 15 days for double-shot keycaps that require tooling. Mass production typically runs 15–20
working days for standard orders, confirmed with your quotation based on quantity and process.

What artwork file formats do you accept?

We accept PDF, AI, STP / STEP, PNG and JPG / JPEG files. Vector artwork (AI, PDF) with outlined
fonts and Pantone (PMS) color references gives the most accurate color match and legend sharpness;
STEP (STP) files help when we tool a new custom profile. Our engineers review every file for
feasibility before quoting.

What materials and printing processes do you offer?

We mould keycaps in PBT, ABS and PC, with legends produced by double-shot injection,
dye-sublimation, reverse dye-sub, UV printing or laser engraving. Double-shot and dye-sub give the
most durable, long-lasting legends. Tooling and mould development are done in-house.

[ 07 ] — Custom keycap FAQ

## Custom keycap manufacturing, answered.

The questions buyers ask us most about MOQ, lead time, artwork and materials for custom OEM / ODM
keycaps.

What is the MOQ for custom keycaps?

Minimum order quantity depends on the printing process. Double-shot keycaps have an MOQ of 2,000
sets, because each colorway needs dedicated mould time; dye-sublimation, silk-screen (pad) printing
and laser-engraved keycap sets start at 500 sets. Using an existing profile avoids new tooling —
send your spec for an exact figure.

How long is the sampling lead time?

Sampling takes about 3–5 days for dye-sublimation, silk-screen and laser-engraved keycaps, and
around 15 days for double-shot keycaps that require tooling. Mass production typically runs 15–20
working days for standard orders, confirmed with your quotation based on quantity and process.

What artwork file formats do you accept?

We accept PDF, AI, STP / STEP, PNG and JPG / JPEG files. Vector artwork (AI, PDF) with outlined
fonts and Pantone (PMS) color references gives the most accurate color match and legend sharpness;
STEP (STP) files help when we tool a new custom profile. Our engineers review every file for
feasibility before quoting.

What materials and printing processes do you offer?

We mould keycaps in PBT, ABS and PC, with legends produced by double-shot injection,
dye-sublimation, reverse dye-sub, UV printing or laser engraving. Double-shot and dye-sub give the
most durable, long-lasting legends. Tooling and mould development are done in-house.

# Panjiva Supply Chain Intelligence Data-driven insights for the global trade community

[Plans and Pricing][13] [Request a Demo][14] [Free Newsletter][15]

## The Panjiva Difference

Panjiva is an intelligence platform that’s bringing transparency to global trade through our robust
global coverage, powerful machine-learning technologies, and dynamic data visualizations. Whether
you’re looking to identify potential business partners, keep track of competitors, or find
investment signals, our platform arms you with unrivaled insights to make supply chain decisions
with conviction. [Learn more][16]

## Smart & Intuitive Analytics

Our platform takes the power of **machine learning** and **data visualization** to give you clear,
actionable insights on global trade.

[Watch Demo][17]

## Find and evaluate legitimate businesses, faster

### 9 million companies and over 2 billion shipment records, just a few seconds away

#### Search for Importers and Exports

Our technology gives you immediate insight into the companies involved at every node of
international supply chains. From manufacturers and buyers to shipping and logistics, Panjiva allows
customers to better understand trade around the globe.

#### Take the data with you

Building a lead list for your sales team? Easily export the results and share them with your team to
expand their reach.

[[Screenshot-supplier-search-for-shirts]][18]
[Supplier Search for shirts]

#### Search your way

Whether you are searching for a product by name or classification, we make it easy. We support
commodity name, HS / HTS code, *D-U-N-S® Number*, and location-based searches.

#### Receive periodic email alerts

Save your search and receive email alerts anytime a new company matches your search criteria, or
when an existing company has new shipment activity.

## A Clear View of Each Company’s Activities

### Information and insights from authoritative customs and business information databases melded
### together to give a 360 degree view of businesses worldwide.

[[An example Panjiva Profile]][19]
[An example Panjiva Profile]

#### Actionable Insights

Powerful reporting capabilities let you spot trends in the import and export activities businesses
across the globe.

#### Top Customers & Suppliers

Discover new opportunities by seeing who does business with your peers or competitors.

#### Contact Information

Access the emails or phone numbers of key decision makers on over 1 million companies.

## A Comprehensive View of Global Trade

### We provide our clients with transactional data covering 35% of global trade flows.
### Armed with this data, you can decide where and when to invest.

#### Competitive Insights

Understand your market share by seeing where your competitors source their goods, and which entities
are involved in the shipment of goods.

#### Risk Analysis

Use our [platform][20] to analyze trade lanes or identify which companies have the riskiest supply
chains.

#### Sales Leads

Whether you’re targeting buyers, suppliers, NVOCCs, or carriers, Panjiva makes it easy to identify
the best sales prospects, learn more about their business, and make contact.

#### Xpressfeed™ Access Available

Use [Xpressfeed™][21] to push leads directly into your CRM system or feed data about publicly-traded
companies into your quant models.

[[Screenshot-network-view-diagram]][22]

# Panjiva Supply Chain Intelligence Data-driven insights for the global trade community

[Plans and Pricing][13] [Request a Demo][14] [Free Newsletter][15]

## The Panjiva Difference

Panjiva is an intelligence platform that’s bringing transparency to global trade through our robust
global coverage, powerful machine-learning technologies, and dynamic data visualizations. Whether
you’re looking to identify potential business partners, keep track of competitors, or find
investment signals, our platform arms you with unrivaled insights to make supply chain decisions
with conviction. [Learn more][16]

## Smart & Intuitive Analytics

Our platform takes the power of **machine learning** and **data visualization** to give you clear,
actionable insights on global trade.

[Watch Demo][17]

## Find and evaluate legitimate businesses, faster

### 9 million companies and over 2 billion shipment records, just a few seconds away

#### Search for Importers and Exports

Our technology gives you immediate insight into the companies involved at every node of
international supply chains. From manufacturers and buyers to shipping and logistics, Panjiva allows
customers to better understand trade around the globe.

#### Take the data with you

Building a lead list for your sales team? Easily export the results and share them with your team to
expand their reach.

[[Screenshot-supplier-search-for-shirts]][18]
[Supplier Search for shirts]

#### Search your way

Whether you are searching for a product by name or classification, we make it easy. We support
commodity name, HS / HTS code, *D-U-N-S® Number*, and location-based searches.

#### Receive periodic email alerts

Save your search and receive email alerts anytime a new company matches your search criteria, or
when an existing company has new shipment activity.

## A Clear View of Each Company’s Activities

### Information and insights from authoritative customs and business information databases melded
### together to give a 360 degree view of businesses worldwide.

[[An example Panjiva Profile]][19]
[An example Panjiva Profile]

#### Actionable Insights

Powerful reporting capabilities let you spot trends in the import and export activities businesses
across the globe.

#### Top Customers & Suppliers

Discover new opportunities by seeing who does business with your peers or competitors.

#### Contact Information

Access the emails or phone numbers of key decision makers on over 1 million companies.

## A Comprehensive View of Global Trade

### We provide our clients with transactional data covering 35% of global trade flows.
### Armed with this data, you can decide where and when to invest.

#### Competitive Insights

Understand your market share by seeing where your competitors source their goods, and which entities
are involved in the shipment of goods.

#### Risk Analysis

Use our [platform][20] to analyze trade lanes or identify which companies have the riskiest supply
chains.

#### Sales Leads

Whether you’re targeting buyers, suppliers, NVOCCs, or carriers, Panjiva makes it easy to identify
the best sales prospects, learn more about their business, and make contact.

#### Xpressfeed™ Access Available

Use [Xpressfeed™][21] to push leads directly into your CRM system or feed data about publicly-traded
companies into your quant models.

[[Screenshot-network-view-diagram]][22]

### From Supply Chain Research

[[2026-07-17-sce-involution-600x370]][23]

##### [Supply Chain Edge: Evolving involution, forecasting transport prices, sourcing Ukraine’s
##### electronics][24]

July 17, 2026

– Mainland China’s anti-involution campaign is set to remain a supply chain policy priority even as
producer prices return to inflation, with the focus shifting from broad capacity cuts to demand
repair, investment discipline and higher returns on capital. The US removal of de minimis...

[More research articles ][25]

## Robust global coverage. Powerful machine learning technologies. Dynamic data visualizations.
## Surge ahead of the competition with Panjiva Supply Chain Intelligence.

## Robust global coverage. Powerful machine learning technologies. Dynamic data visualizations.
## Surge ahead of the competition with Panjiva Supply Chain Intelligence.

### Commercial Bulk: Ingredient & Food Service

Shoreline Fruit is your trusted partner and supplier for fruit products. We offer a broad line of
bulk dried fruit, cherry juice and concentrate, and other fruit products. All products are produced
in food-safety audited facilities with the highest quality.

Contact & Request Samples
][43]

### Product Development

Shoreline Fruit produces and supplies premium ingredients perfect for mixing into food, beverage, or
nutraceutical products. Our ingredient experts will work with your R&D team to find the right
product and specifications for your new product development.

[
Contact Us
][44]
[Hand picking out dried cherries in processing]

### Custom Processing

We support private-label, co-manufacturing, and specialized processing needs. From precision
blending and ingredient specification to packaging solutions, we tailor our production to meet your
exact requirements and specifications. Backed by in-depth production knowledge and quality systems,
we handle custom projects at any scale.

[
Learn More
][45]

## A Family of U.S. Companies & Farming Operations

Shoreline Fruit is the largest tart cherry producer in North America operating nearly 7,000 acres of
cherry orchards right here in Michigan. We are a grower owned company built from two families'
stories filled with pride and hard work that continues to grow in its reach of customers here and
around the globe.

Our growers believe the land we leave for the following generation should be in a better condition
than when we found it, so they manage alongside nature, not against it. Successful farming is a way
of life for our growers and their families, and it is a life they love.

The Challenge

## The agri-food industry runs on opacity and manual effort.

01

### Information Asymmetry

Buyers and suppliers operate with wildly different levels of market visibility. Pricing,
availability, and quality data are fragmented, outdated, or locked behind intermediaries.

02

### Trust & Verification Gap

Finding reliable counterparties requires years of relationship-building, trade shows, and manual due
diligence. Verification is slow, expensive, and often unreliable.

03

### Execution Bottleneck

Even when opportunities are identified, execution remains manual -- outreach, negotiation, logistics
coordination, compliance, and follow-ups consume enormous time and resources.

OUR VISION

## Agri-food trade should work for everyone in it.

We believe that transparent data, verified networks, and intelligent automation can eliminate the
friction that holds global food trade back. Every buyer deserves fair prices. Every supplier
deserves market access. Every transaction should be efficient.

Data LayerNetwork LayerAI Layer

Together, these three layers form the foundation for a fundamentally better way to trade food
globally.
